Only exact wiki numbers that agree with the stage's award_display are kept; the client data wins otherwise. tier_count: how many units the stage's "N%chance" entries give per clear when their chances add up to 100 (the tiers of a stage: each unit picks one tier at those odds), instead of one. rank_counts: the count of an award_display item (by item id) by battle rank (S, A, B), within the award_display range. Left out: Advance Mission and Fierce Assault Lv.35 (no count on the page), Fierce Assault Lv.95 (2 boxes with a T3 40% the award_display doesn't list, its chances add up to 120), Supply Line Disruption and Module Development (no exact per-stage counts), Tactical Training Lv.60 B rank (the wiki's 45 is below award_display's 46~50), every coin amount (approximate on the page, a word in award_display).
